items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section I, List of Answers on Terminology 24:1
items.html: The name “Former” applies to the imparting of the light to the worlds, which includes all of reality except the substance of the vessels. See above, Item 11 and Item 1. (Part 1, Inner Observation, Item 18)
